title: Design System: Our Little Arcade — pink keepsake design

display.purpose: Rounded headings and countdown numerals; 500 weight, -0.02em heading tracking. Main heading clamp(34px, 4vw, 52px); countdown clamp(38px, 4.3vw, 59px).

body.purpose: 16px body with 1.55 line height, readable labels and controls. Labels 14px/700; primary controls 700.

hand.purpose: Short personal notes, 24px desktop and 21px mobile.

shadows.name: keepsake
shadows.purpose: Anniversary page and floating status surfaces; --shadow.

shadows.name: romantic-board
shadows.purpose: Tactile board within the game station.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Pill controls; hover brightness(0.96), press scale(0.97).

motion.name: arcade-confetti
motion.purpose: One falling result celebration; hidden under reduced motion.

motion.name: block-clear
motion.purpose: Brief butter/cherry cell-clear flash; disabled for reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: 150px rail, narrower gutters and home-page gap.

breakpoints.name: stacked
breakpoints.purpose: 96px icon rail and stacked anniversary/question pages.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Fixed bottom navigation with safe-area padding, 20px content gutters, 100px bottom content padding and two-column art rows.

night.purpose: Plum surfaces and light berry actions; preserve contrast through --on-primary. Question writing field retains translucent white and dark berry text.

sourceOrder: Private uploaded artwork or tab-local preview override
artSlots.uploadHandling: Accepted raster images under 10 MB are resized without upscaling to the slot bounds and rasterized as WebP at 0.86 quality; metadata is removed by rasterization. Trusted SVG belongs in local folders. Audio uses folders.
artSlots.preview: Anniversary is saved on this device; uploaded art stays in the current tab.
artSlots.provenance: No fabricated couple photographs. Keep shipping artwork provenance and music attribution in CREDITS.md.

scope.verificationBoundary: Device-local preview review. Hosted migration 005 and two-account connection acceptance remain pending; supplied private RPC/Realtime wiring does not establish hosted sealing, live haptics or deployment. No PWA or APK completion claim.
scope.preview: Pass-and-play games and local session wins clear on reload/sign-out; no online game data saved. Stage 1 anniversary remains device-local and preview art tab-local.
scope.personalData: No baked-in personal names, preferences or anniversary date; optional nicknames are entered in Us.

arcade.surface: Stage 2 arcade within the approved pink keepsake world

chooser.tic: Strawberry cartridge, blush art window, cross/ring geometry
chooser.connect: Lavender cartridge, white art window, cross/heart geometry
chooser.mobile: Single column at 600px; 23px gap; no cartridge offset

rivalry.style: Flat ruled ribbon above chooser and game; Fredoka cherry score numerals, Caveat vs, Nunito Sans names
rivalry.labels: All-time wins · both accounts when signed in; Local session wins in preview
rivalry.nicknameBehavior: Optional nicknames entered in Us; identity comes from the linked account seat rather than a baked-in personal name

station.start: Centered 440px maximum rules panel, paired symbols and player key; Start our game or Continue game
station.hud: Polite live status with symbol, named turn or result, waiting/your-move text and filled-cell counter; max-width 530px

tic.interaction: Square buttons; occupied, busy, finished and other-player turns disable moves without fading pieces

connect.interaction: Seven numbered drop buttons with arrows, minimum 44px by 44px; cells are descriptive display elements. Full columns, busy state, results and other-player turns disable drops

boards.identityRule: Shape distinguishes the two seats independent of color: cross/ring in Tic-Tac-Toe, cross/heart in Connect Four.
boards.night: The approved plum token overrides continue. Cartridge art windows use canvas; butter token foreground uses --on-primary.
boards.artwork: Optional tictactoe-cover, connect4-cover, board-background and piece-cross/piece-circle use existing Slot source precedence. Board art is decorative at opacity 0.12; token images use contain. The existing piece-circle slot serves ring or heart seat art according to game.

result.style: Centered heart, Fredoka 26px result heading, quiet scoreboard copy and Play again pill
result.confetti: 12 geometric pieces, 7px × 12px, 3px radius; cherry, butter and strawberry; 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), staggered 0/.12/.24/.36s; translateY(-30px) to 180px, rotate 240deg and fade
result.reducedMotion: Confetti hidden, animations and control transitions disabled

feedback.gameSound: Off by default; explicit toggle with aria-pressed. Synthesized sine tap 440Hz or result 660Hz, 120ms gain decay; no external audio asset
feedback.haptics: Best-effort navigator.vibrate: 12ms action, [35,50,35] result when the device supports it. Separate from the opt-in sound toggle
feedback.error: Peach notice with alert role and Retry connection action; move processing is locked while busy

responsive.tablet: 850px: tighter cartridge gap and labels; shorter 150px art windows
responsive.mobile: 600px: stacked rivalry and cartridges, 24px station corners, compact HUD and board, thumb-reachable column controls; inherited fixed safe-area bottom navigation

arcade.deferredDestinations: Memories and Notes remain explicit Stage 4 landing screens; wishlist/photos/notes Stage 4, packaging/background push Stage 5, remaining games Stage 6. Stage 3 mood/nudges are now implemented connection surfaces.
arcade.verificationBoundary: Local-preview design handoff. Backend/API/private Realtime wiring is supplied; hosted account setup and live two-device play are unverified. No deployment, APK or PWA completion claim.

blockHeartsDuel.title: Block Hearts Duel
blockHeartsDuel.direction: Extend the approved pocket keepsake without replacing its pink palette or Fredoka/Nunito Sans/Caveat typography. Butter cartridge, peach start page, strawberry shared clock, berry blocks and lavender partner preview.
path: Separate 8 by 8 boards and common deadline

cartridge.layout: Full-width shelf entry, flex on desktop; block at 600px
cartridge.art: 220px basis and 150px height desktop, peach window; 140px basis tablet; 130px tall mobile

start.heading: 36px desktop, 29px mobile
start.durationState: aria-pressed; selected cherry pill, unselected secondary pill
start.artSlot: block-battle-cover with geometric SVG block and heart fallback

lobby.state: Named ready statuses for both seats; current-seat Ready button disables after readiness; cancel waiting match is explicit
lobby.sharedStart: Both ready unlock a three-second countdown; chosen duration remains visible

hud.clock: Fredoka 29px tabular digits with clock icon; Go in N during countdown
hud.scores: Named scores with 25px Fredoka numbers and 22px Caveat vs
hud.mobile: Centered stacked clock and scores; 12px 14px padding

layout.tablet: At 850px: flexible board plus 190px preview, 22px gap
layout.mobile: At 600px: partner preview stacks beneath full-width board; 20px gap; inherited safe-area bottom navigation

board.anchor: Ink 2px circle inside active cell; aria-selected and aria-activedescendant
board.mobile: 16px board radius, 7px padding, 4px gaps, 5px cell radius
board.interaction: Drag a tray piece over the board, preview the entire shape, then release to place if it fits. Tap/select, board-anchor aiming, keyboard arrows/Enter and four 44px directional controls with Place piece remain available.
board.status: Polite row/column and fits/blocked instruction; countdown prevents placement; no-fit state locks that seat's score
board.smallCellRule: Board cells are precise geometry rather than individual large buttons. Keep the 44px arrow alternatives and explicit confirmation

dragPlacement.capture: Primary pointer press selects the piece and captures the pointer; touch-action:none on tray buttons; movement threshold 6px.
dragPlacement.preview: Whole-shape overlay appears only while inside actual board-cell bounds; valid peach/cherry and blocked strawberry/ink previews remain distinct.
dragPlacement.anchor: Anchor is centered around the held shape and clamped by its width/height so all constituent blocks stay within the 8 by 8 board. Selecting a different piece re-clamps the anchor.
dragPlacement.release: Valid inside release commits placement. Blocked or outside release preserves the piece in the tray with Piece returned to the tray feedback; pointer cancellation clears drag state.
dragPlacement.fallback: Click remains select-only; a completed drag suppresses its synthetic click. Keyboard/tap placement remains explicit.

tray.piece: Centered tight-viewBox SVG: width and height derive from shape bounds in 20-unit cells; each block is 18 by 18 at 1-unit inset with 2px corners. Preview SVG is 76px by 64px, centered with 6px bottom margin; mobile height is 55px.
tray.disabled: Used pieces, busy state and inactive play disable selection; used label says Placed
tray.rule: Pieces cannot rotate. Use all three for a fresh tray

shapeColors.purpose: Piece appearance only; selection and fit remain expressed through rings, geometry and text.

tray.cursor: grab at rest; grabbing on press

partnerPreview.miniBoard: 8-column grid, 3px gaps and corners, sheet empty cells and cherry occupied cells; max-width 190px desktop, 90px mobile
partnerPreview.score: Fredoka 45px desktop, 29px mobile; points label in Nunito Sans
partnerPreview.mobile: Compact two-column panel with 90px board beside name and score; rules span full width

blockHeartsDuel.scoringCopy: 10 points per block, 100 per cleared line, 50 extra per additional line cleared together.
blockHeartsDuel.result: Reuse game-result and reduced-motion-aware falling confetti; trophy, winner or perfect tie, both scores, local-demo or saved-scoreboard wording, Battle again pill
blockHeartsDuel.haptics: Best-effort 12ms vibration after placement and [35,40,35] on result; no dedicated new audio behavior
blockHeartsDuel.night: Inherit existing plum token overrides; no new palette. Butter cartridge changes to peach with ink foreground
blockHeartsDuel.preview: Explicit two-player local demo with Control player seat buttons and selected aria-pressed state; no online data saved
blockHeartsDuel.verificationBoundary: Documented from implementation and approved surface brief. API/Postgres membership, authoritative sequence, occupancy, score and deadline wiring is supplied; hosted migration and real two-device acceptance are not established by this document. No deployment claim.

lineClearFeedback.duration: 0.55s ease-out; marked cleared cells reset after 550ms
lineClearFeedback.effect: Butter cell flash with inset 3px cherry border fades to blush with no inset border.
lineClearFeedback.reducedMotion: Clear animation disabled; textual points/line-cleared feedback remains.

signIn.method: Email and password for the two existing private accounts; no public signup or magic-link entry.
signIn.fields: Required Email with autocomplete=email and required Password with autocomplete=current-password; password is masked.
signIn.style: Existing 16px rounded sheet fields, Nunito Sans labels and full-width cherry Sign in pill; preserve current pink keepsake tokens and focus outline.
signIn.states: Signing in… and disabled submit while busy; alert notice for unavailable connection, non-private email or incorrect credentials; password cleared after success.
signIn.verificationBoundary: Documents current form and supplied authentication wiring, not verified hosted credentials or production acceptance.

connections.direction: Extend the approved pink keepsake; lavender daily page alongside anniversary, paired butter/lavender choices, white mood page and full-width peach thinking-of-you ribbon. No new fonts or artwork.

layout.stacked: 900px: single column, 12px gap, 18px top margin; ribbon action fills width

daily.surface: Existing lavender question page beside anniversary
states: Draft textarea and Seal my answer
daily.behavior: Both daily answers open together. Draft is not cleared on failed save; clear follows confirmed own answer state. Preserve whitespace and wrap long text.
daily.preview: Explicit local seat buttons use aria-pressed, 44px minimum height; changing seat shows that player’s sealed/revealed state

choice.title: Would You Rather
choice.tiles: Two columns, 12px gap, minimum 155px height, 24px corners, 22px padding; Fredoka clamp(20px, 2.3vw, 27px), 1.15 line height
choice.colors: First butter, second lavender; night first becomes peach
choice.selected: Inset 3px cherry ring and check icon with aria-pressed
choice.disabled: Choices disable while busy, not ready or after own submission. Opacity stays 1; unselected disabled tile saturates to 0.65
choice.reveal: Own choice sealed until both answer, then show both named picks and Same wavelength or different-pair message
choice.matchPercentage: Rounded matched/total shared-choice percentage with count context; empty state explains that both must choose first
choice.tabletMobile: At 900px activities stack; tiles remain paired, 142px minimum height, 20px padding and 23px text

mood.picker: Five labeled Lucide buttons in one horizontal row; 6px gap, 18px corners, blush surface, 82px minimum height
mood.note: Optional context up to 160 characters in existing rounded field
mood.save: Share my mood or Update my mood; today’s value may be updated
mood.partner: Partner’s named mood, optional note and time, or honest waiting copy
mood.history: Expandable recent check-ins, 44px minimum summary, named mood/date/note rows; 320px maximum list height with vertical scrolling
mood.privacy: Couple-private rather than public; online identity remains authenticated profile

thinkingOfYou.surface: Full-width peach ribbon, 28px radius, 28px 32px padding, 24px gap
thinkingOfYou.mark: Cherry heart on circular sheet, 64px desktop and 48px stacked
thinkingOfYou.action: Cherry Thinking of you pill, minimum 175px width; stacked layout full width
thinkingOfYou.states: No tap yet, incoming tap with timestamp, busy/not-ready disabled, Sent · Ns cooldown
thinkingOfYou.feedback: Best-effort foreground incoming vibration [35,60,35] and status message; successful actions may vibrate 12ms. This is not background push
thinkingOfYou.preview: Switch local seats to see taps; no online data saved

status.surface: Blush status or peach error, 14px corners and 12px 16px padding; wrapped text and retry action
status.loading: Readiness gates answers, choice, mood and taps
status.failure: Migration/refresh/save errors remain visible; retry re-fetches connection state; failed actions do not show success
status.onlineWiring: Supplied connection_state, seal_connection_answer, check_in_mood and thinking_of_you RPC calls with private updates and periodic refresh
status.verificationBoundary: Hosted migration 005 and two-account acceptance remain pending. These are implementation facts, not claims that hosted sealing, private history or live haptics were tested.

connections.nightMotion: Inherit existing plum palette and reduced-motion behavior. No new decorative animation or external assets.

narrative.overview: A pocket keepsake book: strawberry cover, lavender question page, framed personal artwork. Desktop side rail and mobile bottom bar. Home opens on the anniversary, not a marketing hero or card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Desktop side rail and mobile bottom bar
narrative.motion: One spring flourish celebrates the date; controls squish on press. Reduced motion disables animation. Night follows local time with manual toggle. Night Train loops off by default.
narrative.artwork: Artwork uses Slot/useAsset: signed private app-art images, generated local manifest, then icon/gradient fallback. No fabricated couple photographs.
narrative.stageBoundary: Stage 2 extends the approved keepsake world into a small arcade. Play uses two cartridge entries: a strawberry Tic-Tac-Toe with cross/ring pieces and a lavender Connect Four with cross/heart tokens. Each opens a focused start screen, then a tactile board, turn HUD, all-time rivalry ribbon and result screen. Boards use geometry rather than stock illustrations; optional artwork resolves through existing slots. Game sound stays off by default; a short synthesized tap sound needs no external audio asset. A single falling confetti moment marks a result, disabled with reduced motion. Online identity comes from the two linked account seats; nicknames are optional and entered in Us. Preview explicitly uses pass-and-play on this device. Memories and Notes have honest later-stage landing screens; mood, nudges and wishlists remain deferred.
narrative.connectionPages: Daily questions remain beside the anniversary on their lavender page. Would You Rather uses a butter/lavender pair of large choice tiles, followed by a quiet shared reveal and match percentage. Mood uses labeled Lucide icons in a horizontal picker, an optional note and expandable history. A full-width peach ribbon holds Thinking of you. Activities stack on phones and tablets to keep controls generous. Night uses the existing plum tokens. Preview seat controls are explicitly local; online identity remains the authenticated profile. No new external artwork or fonts are needed.
